name: hunt_anchored
_comment: Wave 12 item 1 (IFF), take 3: in the arena (take 2) the pair flew off screen after a few seconds, so ANCHORED copies in Kit FF Range: a Kit Hunter Anchored (gövt 356, yellow; spaceport offer mïsn 1060) on the far mark and a Kit Prey Anchored (gövt 357, cyan; BBS job mïsn 1061) on the near mark, 150 px apart, both neutral to the player, each the other's enemy, own AI. Phase 1: Tab between them with a shot each (the bracket colour of a ship attacking another NPC). Phase 2: target the prey (tab_to cyan) and tickle it 6 s with the Kit Tickler (now the player fights the hunter's victim too); Tab again; then watch the player's shield. Pilot w12_arena2.
